basis: Fictional scenario premises plus bounded analyst inference

dimensions.basis: Director supports exploration, but no signed charter or stop authority is assigned.
No ergonomist or trained fitting staff; qualified assessment capacity is absent.
Lift table and rotation are strengths; residual risk assessment and SOP are absent.
Baseline, storage, cleaning and inspection arrangements are absent; size compatibility is unknown.
$4,000 buying allowance is a strength, but paid training, backfill and recurring support are unfunded.
No trial risk review or withdrawal/incident procedure exists.
No worker consultation; throughput pressure threatens voluntary use.
Purchasing can buy devices; daily fitting, cleaning, inspection and withdrawal have no owner.

go_or_no_go_scope: Supervised station-level evaluation, not production-scale rollout
